sources.title: Children Act, 2013 (Bangladesh Laws)
sources.publisher: Government of Bangladesh, Laws of Bangladesh
sources.use: Jurisdictional child-protection context; includes confidentiality provisions for children involved in proceedings.
sources.limitations: Not a complete safeguarding policy and not legal advice; verify amendments and applicability with Bangladesh counsel.

sources.title: Child Helpline 1098
sources.use: Official Bangladesh child helpline description and access.
sources.limitations: Emergency routing details and service availability must be reconfirmed before release.

sources.title: Bangladesh Police Hotline Numbers
sources.limitations: Numbers and routing may change; verify with agency before release.

sources.title: Fire Service and Civil Defence
sources.publisher: Bangladesh Fire Service and Civil Defence
sources.limitations: Individual guidance must be reviewed for the specific hazard; do not generalise a webpage into a complete response protocol.

sources.title: WHO Physical Activity
sources.use: Population-level physical activity guidance for children and adolescents.
sources.limitations: Not an individual training prescription; medical conditions and symptoms require qualified advice.

sources.title: UNICEF Procedure for a Child Safeguarding Framework
sources.use: Safeguarding framework includes privacy/data protection and media capture considerations.
sources.limitations: UNICEF internal procedure; used as design reference, not as a law or direct policy binding ATHENA.

sources.title: BSEC Investor Education
sources.use: Bangladesh investor education, risk awareness and investor protection topics.
sources.limitations: Education source, not individual investment advice.

sources.title: Bangladesh Bank Financial Literacy Guidelines
sources.use: Financial literacy, clear language, audience adaptation and consumer protection.
sources.limitations: Guideline context; verify current status and any later amendments.

sources.title: Bangladesh Food Safety Authority Laws
sources.use: Current official listing of food safety regulations for food-related learning.
sources.limitations: Specific food-handling content needs current regulation and qualified review.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.use: Testable accessibility success criteria across devices.
sources.limitations: Conformance does not guarantee every user need; conduct user testing.

sources.title: Mobile Accessibility at W3C
sources.use: Explains applying existing accessibility guidance to mobile devices.
sources.limitations: Guidance is not a separate mobile conformance standard.

sources.title: Build an Offline-First App
sources.use: Local source of truth, repository boundaries, sync queues and conflict handling patterns.
sources.limitations: Android architecture guidance; ATHENA still needs its own tested conflict semantics and product requirements.
